constellations.summary: Premier single-target Pyro hypercarry using Guide to Afterlife for massive infused Charged Attacks.
Charged Attacks in Paramita Papilio state no longer consume Stamina (massive mobility and DPS boost).
Increases Blood Blossom DMG by 10% of Max HP and applies it via Burst.
Defeating an enemy affected by Blood Blossom grants +12% CRIT Rate to all teammates.
Prevents death when HP drops below 25%, granting +100% CRIT Rate and +200% all RES for 10s.
